summary.text: Wendy Morgan is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 86, in the November 3, 2026 general election. A homemaker from Perry County, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she grew up in a military family.

paragraphs.text: Wendy Morgan said she lives in New Bloomfield, Perry County, and attended high school in Mifflin County.
According to Ballotpedia, she earned a bachelor's degree from the University of West Florida in 2010 and an associate degree from Platt College in 2018.
She said she has worked with children and animals for most of her adult life and is raising two sons with her husband.
Morgan listed affordability measures, including a higher minimum wage, paid sick and family leave, affordable healthcare and housing, and expanded daycare subsidies, as her first key message.
She also named support for farmers and local students, and for veterans' benefits.
